agent_assumptions: No elevation or other floors supplied: z_floor=0 and ceiling_height=3.0m are explicit assumptions (inherited, unchanged).
Door heights 0-2.1m and window sill/head 0.9-2.4m assumed (standard, not observed in plan; inherited, unchanged).
Wall thickness 240mm per plan labels; interior partitions represented at measured stroke centerlines (inherited, unchanged).
Opening widths from measured cyan jamb runs; swing directions from arcs, door leaf states unknown (inherited, unchanged).
ZoneA seed removed in this revision because the drawn evidence shows no wall between corridor and the former zoneA face; the combined open space keeps the corridor seed and circulation role.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: RESOLVED THIS REVISION (was prior unresolved note): the prior draft claimed the SE suite had no corridor door and a dead-end corridor. Observed evidence shows the former zoneA area is an open ~3.0m-wide alcove of the circulation hall (no wall y~588-695 at x459.5; profile_001), so the hall connects to the SE workroom via D7 and to the exterior via D_Rdouble; corridor is not dead-ended by a missing door.
W_top, W_Rband, W_Lband are ~4.8m continuous cyan bands; mullion subdivision into multiple windows not separable at this resolution (inherited).
Right-hand dimension aggregate labels (4060/1940/5940/3120/4940) not individually re-verified; fine-chain ticks were verified instead (inherited).
D4 leaf/arc geometry read as single door; arcs could indicate double-acting leaf. Room roles inferred from furniture only (inherited).
D1_corridor_head span: cyan-jamb evidence x403-456 vs wall-ink gap x408-451 (~0.28m difference); cyan evidence kept, unresolved.
Whether the open hall alcove (former zoneA) had a intended removable partition cannot be determined from this plan; modelled as drawn (open).
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
